adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a code path that persists third‑party HTML and later renders it without sanitization. `Jobs::PollFeed` takes `i.content` from an RSS/Atom feed (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import` with no HTML sanitization. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post via `PostCreator` using `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` explicitly returns `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == :raw_html`. The embed view then renders it as HTML via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. Together, this is a stored XSS vector if the imported feed content contains `<script>` tags or event-handler attributes, since it will execute on the forum origin when viewed.
